note: PLACEHOLDER numbers, not tuned (Diablo/PoE-style mass-mob 2.5D ARPG; kills about 2 shots, fights <= 5 s). Damage is 360 degrees: facing never blocks or zeroes a hit, it only adds facingBonus on top of the zone multiplier, and the product is capped. The zone comes from the shot (aimZone / impact.zone) or from a seeded weighted roll keyed by weapon, then attackClass, then melee swing kind, then default. Bosses fall through to x1 until per-part hit boxes land behind bossZoneHook (not built).
